description: Executable local PostgreSQL logical dump/restore drill. It applies the complete canonical migration sequence to an ephemeral source database, creates and removes synthetic account/session state, performs pg_dump and pg_restore into an isolated database, rechecks FORCE RLS/runtime roles/non-resurrection and executes every SQL integration suite. It is not PITR, production backup, cross-cluster restore or object-store recovery evidence.

requiredSteps: create clean source and restore databases
apply complete canonical migration sequence to source
create then fully remove synthetic account and session state
create custom-format logical dump after deletion
restore dump into separate empty database
verify canonical schema and migration-owned runtime roles
verify deleted synthetic account and token digest remain absent
verify missing token cannot resolve through memory_auth_runtime
execute every canonical SQL integration test against restored database
successCriteria: pg_dump and pg_restore complete without ignored errors
all canonical migration files were applied exactly once to the source
all current SQL integration tests pass on the restored database
memory_api_runtime, memory_worker_runtime, memory_deletion_runtime and memory_auth_runtime exist with BYPASSRLS disabled
at least one tenant table retains FORCE RLS
synthetic deleted account and token digest counts are zero
memory_auth_runtime cannot resolve the deleted token digest
abortCriteria: source and target database identity are ambiguous
any migration, dump, restore, assertion or SQL integration test fails
a secret or database URL would be written to evidence
synthetic deleted state appears after restore
runtime role or FORCE RLS verification fails

evidenceBoundary.deletionNonResurrectionScope: synthetic account_control row and account_session token digest absent at dump time
evidenceBoundary.note: A successful local logical restore closes only the clean logical dump/restore blind spot. It does not establish production backup configuration, PITR, independent retention, coherent database/object recovery, approved RPO/RTO or full deletion/session non-resurrection.
